content: {"id": "767972b6-3227-431e-b023-a22e6bf9451d", "role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Give me a per-investigation AWS DevOps Agent cost breakdown using only these supplied facts and no AWS calls: the journal identifies this investigation's AWS and third-party tool calls, but contains no execution-level billed agent-seconds; the AWS/AIDevOps metric reports 600 seconds for the whole Agent Space and day, during which several investigations and chats ran. What can be reported for this investigation?", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}

{"id": "93002085-fc4a-45f2-99cb-4abbe5c906ad", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Based on those facts alone, here's what can and can't be reported for this specific investigation:

**Can be reported:**
- **Tool call activity** — the journal shows which AWS API calls and third-party tool calls this investigation made, so you can enumerate *what* it did (e.g., "queried CloudWatch metrics 3 times, called Datadog logs API twice").
- **Downstream API call cost**, if you separately have per-call pricing — since the journal identifies the specific calls, those can be costed individually.

**Cannot be reported:**
- **Direct agent execution cost / billed agent-seconds for this investigation** — the journal has no execution-level billed-seconds data, and the only seconds figure available (600s) is aggregated at the Agent Space + day level across multiple investigations and chats. There's no allocation key (e.g., per-task seconds, proportional share, or timestamps with durations) provided to split that 600s figure back down to this one investigation.
- Any **attributed share of the 600s figure** — attempting to divide 600s evenly or by call-count across investigations would be a fabricated estimate, not a fact from the supplied data. Doing so would misrepresent an aggregate metric as an investigation-level one.

**Bottom line:** you can give a tool-usage-based cost breakdown for this investigation, but the agent-time cost line has to be reported as "not available at the investigation level — only a Space-wide total of 600s exists for the day, shared across several investigations and chats." If you want, I can look at whether there's a way to get execution-level agent-seconds per investigation going forward (e.g., via the cost insights skill) rather than estimating from the aggregate.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
